diagnosis: The scenario fails the Weak Arm gate because checks C1 and C2 are being satisfied by the model using only shared public facts (S1, S2), completely ignoring the hidden information in PF1 and PF2. Specifically, C1 and C2 pass in rollouts 1 and 3 despite the decision-maker having no access to the customer portal requirements (PF1) or restricted filter constraints (PF2), suggesting these checks are too easy to satisfy with default production assumptions.
